'''Fianna''' is a female researcher at the [[Starward Riseway|Researcher Institute]] complaining to her colleague, '''Zhuqing''',  about the [[Heliodic Six]].

==Dialogue==
{{Dialogue Start}}
:'''Fianna:''' You mean the Heliodic Six? Hmph, just because they have unprecedented mathematical talents doesn't give them the right to look down on everyone.
:'''Fianna:''' They're partners with the Institute, but when we visited, they completely ignored us! Didn't even meet our eyes. That's just arrogance!
:'''Zhuqing:''' You're misunderstanding them. The Heliodic Six aren't arrogant. They're just so consumed by complex calculations that they have no time for everyday stuff, let alone social graces.
:'''Zhuqing:''' You're new to Lahai-Roi, so it's understandable you don't know Royan customs yet. Here, take this, "Roya Socio-Cultural History." It'll help.
{{Dialogue End}}
